download_mingw: download a specific version of MinGW compiler for a given architecture and threading model
repository_parse: parse the mingw-builds repository files to get available compiler versions and download URLs
unpack_archive: unpack a mingw-builds archive using 7zip to a specified location on disk
find_7zip: locate the 7zip executable on the system by searching PATH or Windows registry
root_get_compiler: get the root folder of a specific MinGW compiler variant, downloading it if not cached
